special_episode_count.reason: The sources indicate that the OAD consists of a single episode, identified as Episode 23 ('MOMENTS'), which is distinct from the 22-episode TV series.

special_release_date.reason: The OAD 'MOMENTS' (Episode 23) was released as a bonus for the limited edition of Volume 11 of the manga on May 15, 2015. While the BD-Box containing it was released in 2020, the specific release date of the OAD content itself is tied to the manga volume.

answer.identity_notes: The target is the OAD 'MOMENTS' (Episode 23), not the 22-episode TV series. The OAD was originally released with the limited edition of Manga Volume 11 on 2015-05-15. It is a single episode.
